annotations.text:
TIMER MODE, at the phone's own size (393×852 / 852×393; captures in mechanical-reference/). Two changes, both orientations, programmed and free row alike:

1. ONE END. Portrait adopts the accent-outlined 44×44 box landscape already draws (index.css's landscape .timer-end — the connected surface's own End). Plain header text goes.
2. NO DEAD BAND. Portrait: the ◀ ▶ row leaves the bottom edge and sits under Pause as one control group. Landscape: the middle row grows to fill (auto 1fr auto) and the controls row sits on the bottom edge; the face centres in the room it gains.

Everything else is the shipped screen, string for string.

THREE COPY NOTES, batched (PM gates #268 and #272):
3 · the door's band names both buttons (the only invented sentence here — approve or rewrite).
4 · a time-only History row shows TIME 12:34 under its name, using the detail's own label; rows with an average or a distance are untouched.
5 · with no plan the lone save button reads Save, on both log doors; "Save without logging" survives only beneath "Log against plan".

CONTRAST (AA 4.5:1): accent on page (END box) 5.35 · ink on surface (Pause, arrows) 17.11 · ink-3 on page (labels, TIME line) 6.69 · on-color on accent (Save) 5.94 · ink-2 on sunken (band) 9.16. Targets: END 44, Pause 56, arrows 52, buttons 52–56.
